_what: Snapshot of the live, owner-applied protection settings on `main`, plus the two facts about `dev/**` and the milestone merge that the process docs assert. It exists because a documented git setting and the live one drifted apart twice in one day (2026-08-25): the docs said 'linear history off, merge commits allowed' while `main` refused the 0.7.2 PR with 'This branch must not contain merge commits'. Nothing in CI can read GitHub (the test job has no auth), so the doc-to-live comparison is made in two hops: this file is compared with the docs by `tests/test_ci_conformance.py` on every run, and with the live setting by `scripts/branch_protection_snapshot.py --check`, which the owner runs (it needs `gh` auth). Backlog row 6 / issue #46, CR-D-4.
_owner: GitHub branch-protection settings on `main` are the authority. This file is a copy; refresh it with `python scripts/branch_protection_snapshot.py --write`, never by hand.
